disabled.implementation: Renderer replaces multimodal identities with request-scoped UUIDs when both prefix and processor caching are off.

enabled.implementation: Content identities may be reused; encoder manager keys reference/LRU entries by multimodal identity.

limitations: Encoder cache storage remains available for per-request lifecycle even in the disabled cross-request condition.
Enabled identity eligibility does not measure separate encoder-cache hits or savings.
Only actual published cache counters are used; absent encoder-hit counters remain unavailable.
